patterns: Term-meaning one-liners dominate: Yavanapriya = pepper; Vattakirutal = defeated king starving to death.
Indo-Roman trade site/port identification: Arikamedu (Poduke, Wheeler), Muziris as chief centre (APPSC key), Korkai pearls, Puhar Chola.
APPSC-G1 2024 asked Vellalars = rich peasants forming the fourth caste; social-group terms are fair game.
App MCQs cover tinai, Kalabhras and customs well via match/statement formats; PYQs are mostly single-fact.
